title: Road Widening, Santander, Barili, Toledo RD
description: ORGANIZATIONAL OUTCOME 1: ENSURE SAFE AND RELIABLE NATIONAL ROAD SYSTEM, NETWORK DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM, ROAD WIDENING - SECONDARY ROADS, SANTANDER-BARILI-TOLEDO RD - K0219 + 750 - K0220 + 419
colour_meaning: Look first: an official warning record, or two signs of risk together.
contractor: Bidders: Ar Adlawan Construction and Ed1son Development & Construction Inc.

reasons.title: Price per km above 95% of similar works
reasons.detail: Official budget ₱106.6M per km; the 95th percentile of similar works (Road widening, 229 past contracts) is ₱98.0M per km. Length read from the title: 669 m.
reasons.evidence: In past DPWH road contracts this was linked to about 2.2 times the odds of termination.
checks: Check the stated length against the plans or Bill of Quantities; a wrong length distorts price per km.
Look for items that raise cost but are not road surface: drainage, slope protection, bridges, lighting.
Compare unit prices for the main items (concrete, asphalt) with similar contracts nearby.

reasons.title: A bidder had a contract terminated before
reasons.detail: Ar Adlawan Construction: 1 of 59 earlier road contracts terminated; Ed1son Development & Construction Inc.: 1 of 137 earlier road contracts terminated
reasons.evidence: In past contracts, a winner with an earlier termination had about 2.1 times the odds of another; this held on 2023–2025 data.
checks: Open the terminated contracts listed under Bidders and see why they ended (COA report, DPWH order).
Check whether the firm with the termination record is the winner.

claude_note:
**Claude check (advice only):** The ABC of about 71.3M and the 669 m length match the official DPWH record, and the cost per km is only slightly above the comparison threshold; the figures hold up.
**Sources:** confirmed on DPWH API (ABC and stationing match; PhilGEPS notice not attached) · **Suggested next step:** keep priority
